subject: Hank Aaron Award
query: what is the hank aaron award
title: What is the Hank Aaron Award? MLB's top hitter honor, 2026 winners Nov. 11
answer: The Hank Aaron Award honors the most outstanding offensive player of the regular season in each league. MLB created it in 1999, the 25th anniversary of Aaron breaking Babe Ruth's home run record. Winners are picked by a fan vote plus a panel of baseball legends; the 2026 winners are announced Wednesday, Nov. 11, at 9 p.m. ET on MLB Network.
body:
A committee of MLB.com journalists picked 10 finalists per league from the season's top offensive numbers. Fan voting at MLB.com/aaron ran from Oct. 5 to Oct. 12, 2026. The panel of legends and past winners includes Derek Jeter, David Ortiz, Albert Pujols, Ken Griffey Jr., Chipper Jones, Pedro Martínez, John Smoltz, Johnny Bench, Craig Biggio and Eddie Murray.

Shohei Ohtani, a 2026 finalist, won the award three years in a row (2023-2025). Other finalists named by MLB include Jordan Walker and Bobby Witt Jr. The winners are revealed at the MLB Awards at The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas, the same show that unveils the All-MLB Team.
in_the_news: MLB announces the 2026 Hank Aaron Award winners on Nov. 11, 2026, at its awards show in Las Vegas.
